cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Outdo the Effort
cards.instruction: Answer every favor, chore, or sacrifice with a bigger one that restores your lead.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. You brought soup? I'll cook your dinners all week. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're ill. I've already filled your freezer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Then when I'm better, I'll fill yours twice.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine's tiny. Just return the tubs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. I'll bring them back full, with a bigger freezer. That should put me ahead.

mechanism: A confidently organizes repayment of care but yields timing and storage preferences so each larger favor can still restore A lead.
confusable: Unlike simple gratitude, each revealed contribution triggers a larger return; borrowed authority must negotiate how B can accept the escalating repayment.
comparison: Illness, freezer space and tubs differ from transport favors and work-shift sacrifice.
seedUse: Use D43-a soup/full freezer/tiny freezer escalation and S02-a reclaiming an adjusted plan as intentional.
